dedupe_keys.name: data basis of investigation of railway network capacity by means of dynamic flows

description: The dataset author publishes direct CSV inputs for a railway-network dynamic-flow capacity study. Zenodo supplies infrastructure and train files for complete, upper and lower network scenarios under CC BY 4.0. Infrastructure tables give station track counts, single- or double-track lines, minimum headways, hourly capacity bounds and travel times by train type. Train tables give frequencies, routes and minimum dwell times; a small Python file records conflicting station routes. These inputs can benchmark rail throughput and timetable-planning simulations. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this scenario set. Coverage is the study networks and their selected train classes, not a live dispatch database. A limitation is that capacity depends on chosen conflict rules, train mix and minimum headways. The article supplies the method, while the CSVs are the reusable resource. No file was downloaded and no maximum flow was solved or checked.
